doc.title: John LaPorta interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996

title: Closing thanks and upcoming Sarasota performances
summary: The interview ends with thanks and mention of his Prez Conference gig the next night.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I’m so glad you were able to join us today.
Well I am too, this was enjoyable.
And we’ll be listening to you later on this afternoon. And you’re playing this evening?

No. I’ll be playing tomorrow night. I’m playing with the Prez Conference, and then I’ll be playing afterward with more of a local group for when the people come to meet them at the reception. Are you coming to that too?
Oh well great, I’ll see you there.
All right. Thanks so much for your time.
On behalf of Hamilton College I’d like to thank John LaPorta and we’ll be listening.
